compiled_state.title: As a DSO brainstorm agent, I need to automatically classify the epic's architectural class so that orchestrators know before scrutiny whether architectural probes are required
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
Brainstorm automatically classifies the epic's architectural class (class:architectural, class:integration, class:infra, class:behavioral) and writes the classification into the epic spec before scrutiny runs.

## Done Definitions
- Brainstorm writes class:architectural/integration/infra/behavioral into epic spec before scrutiny
- Classification based on ticket content heuristics (presence of schema, integration harness, infra keywords)
- Classification is machine-readable field in epic spec (not prose)
- Unit tests cover each classification category

## Considerations
- Config key namespace plan required: S4 introduces class:architectural, S6 introduces bypass-log config, S7 removes legacy flags. Coordinate config key naming to avoid collisions before implementation.

## SC Coverage
SC4

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
